lastAssistantText:
Done. Single self-contained `index.html` is built and verified.

**Verification performed**
- `node --check` on the extracted `<script>` → **SYNTAX_OK**
- No external/network references (no `<script src>`, `<link>`, CDN, `http(s)://`, `@import`) → fully offline
- Temp check file cleaned up; no stray files left

**Delivered: `index.html` (11.6 KB, all HTML/CSS/JS inline)**

Features implemented:
- **Keyboard controls** — Arrow keys + WASD, buffered via input lock to prevent 180° reversals
- **Food** — spawns only on empty cells; board-full win state
- **Scoring** — +10/food; persistent best score in `localStorage` (`snake:best`)
- **Collisions** — wall hit and self-collision (with legal tail-vacate chase), both end the run
- **Pause** — `Space`/`P`, plus auto-pause on window blur; resume button
- **Restart** — `R` or `Enter`, or Play button; full state reset
- **Increasing difficulty** — tick interval drops 6 ms/food (150 ms → 60 ms floor) via a RAF time-accumulator; level shown in the HUD

To play, just open `index.html` in a browser (double-click or drag into a browser). No server needed.

One note on verification: the harness has no browser automation available, so I confirmed JS syntax and static structure but did not run a live in-browser play session. That final manual click-to-play is the one step left for you.
limitations: No independent browser/visual testing; earlier browser-origin denial honored. VM/DOM/canvas shims do not establish browser compatibility or visual polish.
Single trial per task and configuration; sampling variance prevents strong causal attribution.
